title: Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery: Approved Monthly Amount of Reduced Withholding
content:
**Rule.** The approved monthly withholding on a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery** is the withholding proposed on the latest reduced-withholding request on the debt, at the standard rate of 100 percent, rounded up to the cent, and never below the smallest reduced withholding of the debt type.

## Definition of each element

- **The proposal** — the monthly withholding stated on the latest reduced-withholding request on the debt, by date of receipt; where the debt holds no such request, the proposal is zero.
- **The rate** — the proposal is multiplied by 100 percent.
- **Rounding** — the product is rounded up to the cent once.
- **The floor** — the rounded figure is raised to the smallest reduced withholding of the debt type (schedule of repayment terms) if lower.

## Worked examples (hypothetical inputs, smallest reduced withholding taken as 25.00 USD)

| Latest proposal | At 100 percent, rounded up | Approved withholding |
|---|---|---|
| 96.60 USD | 96.60 USD | 96.60 USD |
| 18.40 USD | 18.40 USD | 25.00 USD |
| No reduced-withholding request on the debt | 0.00 USD | 25.00 USD |
